incidents.summary: Helios Towers and the two acquisition targets paid a combined US$102,101.765 penalty for late merger notification to COMESA, which subsequently approved the acquisition without conditions.

sources.title: Comesa approves Malawi Towers share acquisition - Nation Online
sources.quote: In a statement on Monday signed by its registrar Meti Disasa, the commission said the parties have since paid $102 101.765 (about K82 million) in penalties for failure to notify the commission of its proposed acquisition transaction in time.

sources.title: Notice of Inquiry into the Proposed acquisition by Helios Towers Ltd of shares of Madagascar Towers S.A. and Malawi Towers Limited - COMESA Competition and Consumer Commission

incidents.summary: Malawi’s labour minister inspected Helios Towers Malawi following complaints of unfair dismissals and employee mistreatment, and required a written response within seven days.

sources.title: Minister demands order in hiring of expatriates – The Times Group
sources.quote: Among other issues, the complaints centred on unfair labour practices, such as the dismissal of Malawians from key positions, which were allegedly subsequently filled by expatriates.

sources.title: Minister demands order in hiring of expatriates – The Times Group
sources.quote: There were also allegations of mistreatment of employees by some senior officials at the company.

sources.title: Minister demands order in hiring of expatriates – The Times Group
sources.quote: Helios Towers Malawi has since been given seven days to submit a written response to the ministry regarding the matter.

positives: Helios Towers installed solar panels at 313 Ghanaian sites in 2023, supplying renewable energy to 38% of its national portfolio.
Supplier partners received solar installation and maintenance training as part of the Ghana rollout.
